data.Name: The Public Suffix List
data.Description:
The Public Suffix List is an initiative of Mozilla,
but is maintained as a community resource. It is available for use in any software,
but was originally created to meet the needs of browser manufacturers.
It allows browsers to, for example:

- Avoid privacy-damaging "supercookies" being set for high-level domain name suffixes

- Highlight the most important part of a domain name in the user interface

- Accurately sort history entries by site
data.QtUsage:
Used in Qt Network to avoid setting "supercookies" in the cookie jar
supported by Qt (by the QNetworkCookieJar class).
data.Comment: Updated by util/update_public_suffix_list.sh; if you add fields here, update the script, too!
data.Copyright:
The list was originally provided by Jo Hermans <jo.hermans@gmail.com>.
It is now maintained on github (https://github.com/publicsuffix/list).

data.Name: libpsl - C library to handle the Public Suffix List
data.Description: Libpsl allows checking domains against the Public Suffix List.
data.QtUsage:
